structuredContent.summary: The current `IDS_ROADIUM_SHIELDS_SITE_SCOPE` string incorrectly claims temporary exceptions only cover regular tabs. Analysis of `AdblockChromeContentBrowserClient::GetBrowserContextForEyeoFactories` confirms that the backend always returns the `GetOriginalProfile()`, meaning the filtering context is shared across both regular and private tabs. I recommend updating the help text to accurately reflect that exceptions apply to all views (including private tabs) and that other open tabs require a reload to apply changes.
architecture_observations: `GetBrowserContextForEyeoFactories` remaps any context to the original profile, ensuring a shared filtering state.
Private tabs (OffTheRecord) are not isolated from the adblock filtering logic.
Temporary exceptions are stored in a separate memory vector on the original profile's configuration.
UI controls only trigger reloads for the current tab; existing tabs remain in their previous state until reloaded.

proposed_changes.change: Update `IDS_ROADIUM_SHIELDS_SITE_SCOPE` to include private tabs and clarify the reload requirement for other tabs.

structuredContent.patch:
--- a/chrome/browser/adblock/android/adblock_strings.grd
+++ b/chrome/browser/adblock/android/adblock_strings.grd
@@ -215,7 +215,7 @@
       <message name="IDS_ROADIUM_SHIELDS_SITE_PANEL_TITLE" desc="Shields per-site panel: panel title">Shields</message>
-      <message name="IDS_ROADIUM_SHIELDS_SITE_SCOPE" desc="Shields per-site panel: scope">Applies to this host and its subdomains. Temporary exceptions cover regular tabs until the browser restarts. Closing a tab does not end the exception.</message>
+      <message name="IDS_ROADIUM_SHIELDS_SITE_SCOPE" desc="Shields per-site panel: scope">Applies to this host and its subdomains. Temporary exceptions cover all tabs (including private) until the browser restarts. Other open tabs must be reloaded to apply changes. Closing a tab does not end the exception.</message>
       <message name="IDS_ROADIUM_SHIELDS_SITE_GLOBAL_PAUSED" desc="Shields per-site panel: global paused">Protection is paused globally. Removing a site exception will not enable global protection.</message>
risks: Minimal risk; this is a documentation/UI string correction.
tests: Verify the updated string appears correctly in the Shields per-site panel in the Android UI.
